products.name: Royal Canin Medium Adult Dry Dog Food
products.description: Complete dry dog food formulated for medium-breed adult dogs. Royal Canin publishes this recipe in 4 lb, 17 lb, 30 lb and 40 lb bags, and its own product page supplies the pack image, the bag identifier and the price used for this 4 lb listing.
products.image_alt: Bag of Royal Canin Medium Adult dry dog food for medium-breed adult dogs
products.notes: Official page also lists 17 lb at USD 61.99, 30 lb at USD 99.99 and 40 lb at USD 109.99.

products.name: Royal Canin Maxi Puppy Dry Dog Food
products.description: Complete dry puppy food for large-breed puppies, listed here in the 3 kg bag. The Royal Canin UK page publishes the pack image, the bag identifier and the price for this size, so the listing uses that bag rather than a converted US size.
products.image_alt: Bag of Royal Canin Maxi Puppy dry puppy food for large-breed puppies
products.notes: UK page also lists the 15 kg bag at GBP 72.99 (SKU 1-3182550402163).

products.name: Pedigree Adult Dry Dog Food, Roasted Chicken Rice & Vegetable
products.description: Complete and balanced dry adult dog food in roasted chicken, rice and vegetable flavour, in a 44 lb bag. Pedigree's own pages for this recipe returned errors during research, so the image, price and pack identifier come from a retailer listing of the same recipe.
products.image_alt: Bag of Pedigree Adult dry dog food, roasted chicken, rice and vegetable flavour, 44 lb
products.notes: Retailer SKU 189800, UPC 023100143538. Other retailers listed the 18 lb bag from USD 21.99 to USD 25.29.

products.name: Purina Dog Chow Complete Adult Dry Dog Food With Real Chicken
products.description: Complete dry dog food with real chicken flavour for adult dogs, in a 44 lb bag. Purina's own page confirms the recipe and its 4.4, 18.5, 44 and 48 lb sizes, while the price and pack shot for the 44 lb bag come from a retailer listing.
products.image_alt: Bag of Purina Dog Chow Complete Adult dry dog food with real chicken, 44 lb
products.notes: Retailer SKU 106970, UPC 017800806725. Other retailers listed the 18.5 lb bag from USD 15.99 to USD 19.99.

products.name: Hill's Science Diet Adult Chicken & Barley Dry Dog Food
products.description: Science Diet adult dry dog food in chicken and barley flavour for dogs one to six years old, in a 15 lb bag. Hill's publishes the recipe details and 3675 kcal/kg on its own page, while the price and pack image for this size were read from a retailer.
products.image_alt: Bag of Hill's Science Diet Adult Chicken and Barley dry dog food, 15 lb
products.notes: Hill's official sizes are 2, 5, 15, 35 and 45 lb. The image is the retailer's pack shot because hillspet.com blocks downloads.

products.name: Eukanuba Adult Medium Breed Dry Dog Food
products.description: Eukanuba adult dry dog food for medium breed dogs, in a 30 lb bag. Eukanuba's own page supplies the pack image and the manufacturer identifier for this recipe, while the price was read from a Canadian retailer listing that had it in stock.
products.image_alt: Bag of Eukanuba Adult Medium Breed dry dog food, 30 lb
products.notes: A US retailer listed the same 30 lb bag at USD 74.99 but flagged it out of stock, so the Canadian in-stock price was used. Eukanuba's own pack shot is a 23 MB PNG, so the retailer's 1024 px version is used instead and attributed to G&E Pharmacy.

products.name: Purina ONE Chicken & Rice Adult Dry Dog Food
products.description: Purina ONE adult dry dog food in chicken and rice, in a 16.5 lb bag. Purina's own page confirms the recipe, bag sizes from 3 lb to 44 lb, and real chicken as the first ingredient with no fillers, while the price and pack image come from a retailer.
products.image_alt: Bag of Purina ONE Chicken and Rice adult dry dog food, 16.5 lb
products.notes: Retailer SKU 63750, listed in stock at USD 30.28. A second retailer listed USD 35.99 for the same 16.5 lb bag. The retailer calls the recipe SmartBlend, which is Purina's older line name for it.
